newsitem.title: USA: Chattanooga, Tenn., mayor drafts $131.6 mln budget.
newsitem.headline: Chattanooga, Tenn., mayor drafts $131.6 mln budget.

text.p: Chattanooga Mayor Jon Kinsey has submitted a $131.6 million budget proposal that would leave property tax rates unchanged, the Free Press reported Wednesday.

The fiscal 1998 budget would increase spending by $2.86 million or 2.2 percent over this year. It would give city workers a 5.0 percent raise and leave the property tax rate at $2.70 per $100 of assessed value.
Kinsey said the budget for the year beginning July 1 anticipates $13 million of additional revenue from the city's local-option sales tax.
